title: Policy on Optimal Epilepsy Management
brief_summary: This study examines the use of an online social media platform (PatientsLikeMe) to assist Veterans with epilepsy. The hypothesis is that the online social media platform, PatientsLikeMe, will improve selected patient-reported outcomes on perceived self-management skills for patients who engage in the website functions.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* US Veteran
* Epilepsy (Seizure Disorder)
* \>18 years

Exclusion Criteria:

\-
